content_completeness_regressions.note: v1's body text ("We know that not every problem occurs at a convenient time...") was drawn from block 23, which was never in the numbered copy list handed to the design session -- a real copy-rule violation. The revision fixed the violation by DELETING the text rather than sourcing compliant text, leaving the card as a bare heading with no supporting copy. Correct per the copy rule; a regression in craft and page balance (the Plumbing card beside it still carries two lines of real body text, so the row now reads unevenly).
Same cause and same trade-off as the Electrical card -- v1's text came from block 9, also outside the numbered copy list.

v1 rendered a 2x2 grid of labelled before/after stat tiles (Indoor temperature, Airflow, Temperature split) by slicing individual values out of one real but run-on sentence (job_story_block_32[1]), which is itself a copy-rule violation (selecting sub-sentence fragments, not whole listed sentences). The revision replaced it with two full verbatim sentences as flowing prose -- correct per the copy rule, but a plainer, less scannable presentation of the same real result.
